OmniControl Suite v8.15.1 - System Tools Layout & Fan Sync Fix:
- Fixed overlapping cards in System Tools (eliminated stray network and process cards).
- Clean, full-width Storage & Shader Cleaner and Startup Manager views.
- Synchronized 100% Max Fans toggle: Toggling off now automatically restores AI Smart mode without manual switching.
- Removed disruptive modal dialogs for a seamless in-app experience.
